name: Sirdata CMP
description: Loads the Sirdata Consent Management Platform (CMP) consent-banner scripts on the front end from two admin-entered keys.
project_description:
Back to top 

 OVERVIEW 
 Sirdata CMP is a Consent Management Platform made to reply to privacy regulations such like GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA and already used by thousands of websites.

Sirdata provides a CMP certified (IAB Transparency & Consent Framework V2.1) and compatible with all players in the programmatic and eCommerce markets.

Its dedicated team combines legal, technical and commercial expertise to continually support you with your compliance, maximize your revenues and optimize your activities’ performance.

Sirdata decided to facilitate Drupal’s clients compliance process by providing this turnkey module.

 Back to top 

 HOW IT WORKS ? 
 
 Activate the module in your Drupal Account 
 Create or log in to your Sirdata CMP account 
 Set up your CMP in few minutes (or use the pre-configured one) 
 Paste your ‘partner’ and ‘config’ IDs in this Drupal dedicated module (no need to touch the source code) 
 Add mandatory mentions in your Privacy Policy pages 
 
 Back to top 

 FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS 
 Sirdata CMP offers many features: 
 
 16 languages available (English, French, Spanish, …): automatically disclosed in the browser language but any specific language can be set up 
 Design personalization: Format, position, color, logo, responsive Design, dark mode, ... 
 User choices report :  understand your user's choices behavior and AB-test different setups to optimize your consent rate 
 Google AMP (Accelerated Mobile Pages) compatibility: Sirdata CMP works in the specific Google AMP environment, as well as with any Desktop or mobile internet browsers 
 IAB Europe Transparency and Consent Framework (V2.1) compatibility: Sirdata CMP relies on the open-source TCF API to let partners (vendors) control the users' consent status, storage of the consent collection date to demonstrate compliance, … 
 ... 
 
 Exclusive features: 
 
 Valid consent by default: no bad set up is possible, the CMP only admits GDPR, ePrivacy and CCPA compliant settings . 
 
 Eg: as the French DPA requests a “refuse” button in the CMP 1st screen, Sirdata CMP automatically pushes one in France 
 
 Consent Framework: Sirdata CMP is the only one to propose its partners to share and be shared the Users ‘s choices of the other websites members of its framework. Thanks to this choices’ co-op, the user experience is improved and so the business opportunities are optimized.  https://www.consentframework.com/#/ 
 Easy Tag Management (with or without TMS) to proceed to the conditioning of your tags without using JavaScript commands  
 
 https://cmp.docs.sirdata.net/v/en/script-management/tag-conditioning   
 
 ... 
 
 Other services proposed by Sirdata: 
 
 Audit: How good is your compliance? Benefit from Sirdata expertise: 
 
 https://www.sirdata.com/en/Publishers 
 
 Tag Management setup service: if you do not wish to manage the conditioning of your tags by yourself, Sirdata can take care of it 
 
 https://cmp.docs.sirdata.net/v/en/script-management/tag-conditioning-se…   
 
 Analytics Helper 
 ... 
 
 Back to top 

 SUPPORT 
 Don’t hesitate to:

 
 Look at Sirdata CMP Technical Documentation: https://cmp.docs.sirdata.net/ 
 Contact Sirdata CMP Team at support@sirdata.com for any question/assistance 
 
 Back to top 

 DISCLAIMER 
 This module allows you to display Sirdata CMP on your Drupal website.

The use of this module doesn’t guarantee compliance with global privacy laws (GDPR, ePrivacy, CCPA, …). A CMP is just one part of a whole compliance process.
